propositions: test_ac0_blob_ref_roundtrips_through_remote fails deterministically with 'git -C <bare.git> cat-file' exit 128 when git config safe.bareRepository=explicit is injected via GIT_CONFIG_* environment variables
Under safe.bareRepository=explicit policy, git refuses implicit repository discovery and rejects 'git -C <bare.git>' against bare repos, but 'git --git-dir <bare.git>' remains permitted
The test's _git() helper uses 'git -C' for bare fixture introspection instead of explicit '--git-dir' naming, creating a test-portability defect that prior art in _git_upkeep.py already solves
The push to the bare remote succeeds and the object exists; only the verification step (cat-file -t, rev-parse) is refused by the security policy
Fix requires routing bare-repo git invocations through a --git-dir-based helper matching the _git_upkeep pattern, while keeping work-tree repos on '-C'
